messages.welcome:
⚠️ CODE RED - ALL UNITS RESPOND

Ranger, this is Chief Morrison. We have a situation. Someone calling themselves 'The Matchmaker' has been sending us encrypted messages for the past hour.

10 minutes ago, the first fire started.

They're toying with us - riddles, false leads, and real fires scattered across the city. Every second counts. Decode their twisted clues, find the real fires, and put them out before this escalates.

The city is depending on you. Don't let them win this game. Move out!
messages.falseAlarmMessage: DISPATCH: False alarm, Ranger. The Matchmaker is messing with us - planted fake smoke signals to waste your time. Every fake call costs us 30 seconds. Stay sharp and trust your instincts!

quest1.title: The First Spark
quest1.riddle:
THE MATCHMAKER: Message 1/5

'Little voices echo where the wooden giants sleep,
Swings of joy now silent, shadows dark and deep.
Dried memories crackle best when kissed by flame,
Find my gift before the innocence goes up in shame.'

⏰ Timer starts NOW.
quest1.successMessage:
FIRE EXTINGUISHED!

Chief Morrison: 'Playground saved! That sick bastard doused the jungle gym in accelerant. Parents were bringing kids in 20 minutes. You did good, Ranger.'

[THE MATCHMAKER]: '1 down, you're quicker than I thought. Let's raise the stakes...'

quest2.title: The Red Herring
quest2.riddle:
THE MATCHMAKER: Message 2/5

'A crimson stallion rests where morning light awakes,
Two wheels, one tank, such beautiful mistakes.
Not the fleet that roars, but the one forgotten,
Eastern winds will carry the boom I've begotten.'

P.S. - I left you some DISTRACTIONS. Choose wisely, hero.
quest2.successMessage:
CRITICAL SAVE!

Chief Morrison: 'Jesus... the fuel line was rigged to blow. Whole eastern block would've gone up. Cyclist left it here this morning, said a 'mechanic' offered a free tune-up.'

[THE MATCHMAKER]: 'Impressive. But did you waste time on my decoys? Tick tock...'

quest3.title: A Burning Problem
quest3.riddle:
THE MATCHMAKER: Message 3/5

'Society's shame, tucked behind closed doors,
Metal mouths that swallow what nobody adores.
One man's trash, my canvas for disaster,
Find the container before the flames spread faster.'

HINT: Not all smoke signals lead to fire... 🔥🔥🔥💨💨
quest3.successMessage:
BLAZE CONTAINED!

Dispatch: 'Dumpster was packed with oily rags and propane canisters! Fire was spreading to the apartment building - 47 residents evacuated. You got there just in time!'

[THE MATCHMAKER]: 'You're good. Too good. Time to make this PERSONAL...'

quest4.title: Unlucky Number
quest4.riddle:
THE MATCHMAKER: Message 4/5

'Superstition marks the tower of despair,
Five plus ten, families gasping for air.
Look UP where messages hang in the sky,
Wave goodbye to those who are about to die.'

🆘 URGENT: Multiple 112 calls reporting smoke! This is the REAL one!
quest4.successMessage:
LIVES SAVED!

Chief Morrison: 'Ranger, that was a fifth-floor apartment - family of four trapped at the window! Kitchen fire spreading fast. You're a damn hero. But we got one more message...'

[THE MATCHMAKER]: 'Congrats, HERO. Saved some civilians. But can you save your LEGACY?'

quest5.title: Race Against Time
quest5.riddle:
THE MATCHMAKER: FINAL MESSAGE

'Where power sits and history sleeps in files,
Corruption burns beautifully - can you run the miles?
The heart of the city, the clock counts down,
Your finale awaits in the center of town.'

Every. Record. Every. Secret. ASHES.

You have 2 minutes. I'll be watching. 🔥👁️
quest5.successMessage:
🎖️ MISSION COMPLETE!

Chief Morrison: 'CITY HALL SAVED! Archives secured, every document intact. Fire started in the records room - would've destroyed 100 years of history. We got surveillance footage... suspect fleeing. Units in pursuit.'

[THE MATCHMAKER - INTERCEPTED]: 'You won this round, Ranger. But fire never truly dies... it just waits.'

⭐ CITY SAVED - OUTSTANDING WORK!
